title: V1 Core Bookkeeping - compliance matrix

milestones.M1: Ledger core: chart of accounts, period states, PostingService, journals, general ledger, trial balance
milestones.M2: Contacts as customers/suppliers, VAT foundation, sales, credit notes, receipts
milestones.M4: Bank accounts, statement import, transfers, charges, interest, reconciliation
milestones.M5: Profit and loss, balance sheet, drill-down to documents, controls and alerts
milestones.M6: V1 UI slices behind feature flags (DEC-002)

acceptance: A milestone is accepted by the product owner on an acceptance package: commit SHA, CI run (every job), test results, migrations, security/permission checks, matrix changes, known limitations (DEC-007).

rows.note: V0 contacts exist (master data); customer role/terms are V1
Foundation only; MTD returns are V5

rows.req: Accounting Periods (explicit states and close controls)
rows.ev: V0: accounting_period table with OPEN/CLOSED/LOCKED enum, no-overlap constraint, create/list API. No transition rules, no enforcement on postings.

rows.req: Source document -> transaction service -> PostingService -> journal -> journal lines -> ledger
rows.note: M1 delivers PostingService + journals + ledger with manual and reversal sources; each later milestone adds a transaction service

rows.req: Financial statements are never calculated from source transactions (Trial Balance -> P&L / Balance Sheet)
rows.note: Trial balance in M1; statements in M5, both from journal lines only
Account-level treatment in M1; VAT codes on lines arrive with the VAT foundation (M2)

rows.req: PostingService is the sole service authorised to post ledger entries
rows.note: Enforced by an architecture test, a database guard (transaction flag) and privileges
Validator chain exists from M1; the VAT validator ships with the VAT foundation
Base currency of the company only; foreign-currency postings and FX revaluation are not in V1 scope until a decision is recorded

rows.req: Sale: Dr Trade Receivables / Cr Revenue / Cr Output VAT
Purchase: Dr Expense/Asset / Dr Input VAT / Cr Trade Payables
Receipt: Dr Bank / Cr Trade Receivables
Payment: Dr Trade Payables / Cr Bank
Credit notes reverse or adjust the original economic effect with full source linkage
rows.note: Sales credit notes M2; purchase (debit) notes M3. The reversal primitive and source linkage ship in M1
Asynchronous job with progress; file formats to be decided in the M4 design
Rule-based suggestions; AI suggestions are V6 and may only propose
Trial balance in M1

rows.req: Drill-down: Report -> account -> journal -> source transaction -> document
rows.note: Report -> account -> journal in M1; source transaction and document links arrive with each source module
Trial balance warning in M1; dashboard alert in M5

rows.ev: V0 audit framework (append-only, before/after, reason, source workflow). Ledger actions are not yet audited.

rows.req: Every posting rule: positive, negative, reversal, VAT and period-lock tests
rows.note: Applied per rule as each milestone adds rules; the matrix lists the rule set tested

rows.req: Only the central PostingService can create posted ledger entries
rows.note: Same as V1-POST-01
Privileges, triggers, tests
Application and deferred database check

rows.req: Every posted journal has source, user/system actor, timestamp and audit metadata
Every source transaction is traceable to its journal
rows.note: Journal -> source in M1 (source_type/source_id); source -> journal per module

rows.req: Every report number is drillable to ledger/source evidence
rows.note: Same as V1-RPT-02

rows.req: Accounting periods have explicit states and close controls
rows.note: Same as V1-MOD-19

rows.req: Tax and reporting rules are effective-dated/versioned
rows.note: Reporting mappings versioned in M1; VAT rates effective-dated in M2

rows.req: AI cannot silently post accounting entries or submit filings
rows.note: PostingService refuses AI actors; architecture test keeps the AI module away from the posting code
TransactionPosted in M1; BankImported M4; InvoiceCreated M2
DEC-002: parallel behind feature flags
